integrity: All-poset statements follow from a written symbolic proof. Finite exact checks across 407 partial orders of at most five elements are corroborative and not a substitute for that proof; independent validation has not occurred.
limitations: The exact outer-sphere and contact theorem concerns the canonical ordinary-poset specialization of signed-chain inequalities, not arbitrary signed type-B posets or affine images; historic priority remains provisional.
title: A second-Greene-width outer-sphere law for classical signed-chain polytopes
